# superset_chart (Resource)

Manages a chart. Place a chart on a dashboard through the `position_json` of the dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_chart" "daily_signups" {
  name          = "Daily signups"
  datasource_id = superset_dataset.signups.id
  viz_type      = "echarts_timeseries_line"
  description   = "Signups per day over the last month"
  cache_timeout = 300

  params = jsonencode({
    viz_type   = "echarts_timeseries_line"
    x_axis     = "day"
    metrics    = ["count"]
    time_range = "Last month"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datasource_id` (Number) Identifier of the dataset the chart is built on.
- `name` (String) Name of the chart.
- `params` (String) JSON document with the form data of the chart, as shown in the chart's `View query` and `Edit chart properties` dialogs. Formatting differences are not reported as drift.
- `viz_type` (String) Visualization type, for example `table` or `echarts_timeseries_line`.

### Optional

- `cache_timeout` (Number) Duration in seconds for which the chart data is cached. Unset to use the timeout of the dataset or database.
- `certification_details` (String) Details of the certification.
- `certified_by` (String) Person or group that certified the chart.
- `datasource_type` (String) Type of the datasource: `table` (a dataset, the default), `query`, `saved_query` or `view`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description of the chart.
- `owners` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the users who own the chart. Defaults to the user the provider authenticates as.
- `query_context` (String) JSON document with the query context of the chart, which Superset uses for alerts, reports and cache warm-up. When unset, the query context Superset generates on its own is left alone.
- `tags` (Set of String) Names of the tags attached to the chart, with the `TAGGING_SYSTEM` feature flag. When unset, the tags are left as they are; when set, the chart has exactly these tags. Tags that do not exist yet are created, and stay when the chart is destroyed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the chart.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Charts are imported by their numeric id.
terraform import superset_chart.daily_signups 42
```
